entries.title: Session start
entries.gotchas: Run before mutation. USER.md Personal wins. Read-only until implementation intent.

entries.title: task check
entries.gotchas: Merge chokepoint. Iteration may use cheaper affected gates; do not skip this before PR.

entries.title: Doctor
entries.gotchas: Support entry is doctor --full or the README cold-start. Not a second recovery ladder.

entries.title: Install / init
entries.gotchas: Consumer path is directive init. Do not send npm consumers through Corepack, Go, or uv.

entries.title: Setup skill
entries.gotchas: Writes USER.md and PROJECT-DEFINITION. Confirm captured values before write.

entries.title: Build skill
entries.gotchas: xbrief:preflight on an active running brief before code. Do not treat completed xBRIEFs as next-build contract.

entries.title: Public docs home
entries.gotchas: Public IA lives under docs-site/. Do not mix it with maintainer docs/.

entries.title: Public install page
entries.gotchas: Install copy stays on the consumer Node floor, not the maintainer toolchain pin.

entries.title: Public gates page
entries.gotchas: task check is the merge chokepoint named here; do not invent a parallel public gate.

entries.title: Public concepts page
entries.gotchas: Concepts page is a public IA surface. README/UPGRADING rewrites stay on #4100.

entries.title: Public upgrade page
entries.gotchas: Frozen pre-v0.20 migration stays on the v0.59.0 hop. Current npm uses migrate:xbrief.

entries.title: Public license page
entries.gotchas: License page is a docs-site surface, not a substitute for root LICENSE.

entries.title: Rule map
entries.gotchas: Generated maintainer view. Do not mint a second RULE-MAP. Refresh with task docs:rule-map.

entries.title: Policy inspector
entries.gotchas: Read namespaced plan["x-directive/policy"]. Bare plan.policy is a shadowing stop.

entries.title: Pre-PR skill
entries.gotchas: Run before opening a PR. Always-pin process skill; not this capability index.

entries.title: Review-cycle skill
entries.gotchas: Greptile residuals go through this skill. Host babysit/bugbot are advisory-only.

entries.title: Swarm skill
entries.gotchas: Drive-to merge-ready is the default story unit. Parent must not implement as the leaf.

entries.title: Encoding gate (alias)
entries.gotchas: Alias owner is dispatch.ts VERB_ALIASES. Canonical engine verb is verify-encoding.

entries.title: Frozen vBRIEF migrator
entries.gotchas: Current npm does not ship this verb. Pin v0.59.0 for hop 1, then migrate:xbrief.

entries.title: Triage classify (withdrawn)
entries.gotchas: Classify playbook is off. Work selection is plan-sequence:current then triage:queue.

entries.title: Product-signal consent
entries.gotchas: Off until the operator grants consent. Absence of consent is not a product verdict.
